title: Formal local presentations with a specified coefficient section
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $A$ a commutative local $k$-algebra with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ and residue field $F=A/\mathfrak m$ (the residue-field construction of [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]), and $C=\widehat A=\varprojlim_r A/\mathfrak m^r$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. A formal local presentation consists of integers $n\ge2$, $s\ge0$, a $k$-algebra map $\sigma:F\to C$ whose composite with the canonical reduction $C\to A/\mathfrak m=F$ is the identity, and a surjective $k$-algebra map $\Phi:F[[t_1,\ldots,t_n]]\to C$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] with $\Phi(c)=\sigma(c)$ for constants $c\in F$, together with $s$ specified power series $f_j$ generating $\ker\Phi$, such that $\ker\Phi\subseteq(t_1,\ldots,t_n)$. Require $\Phi$ to be continuous for the $(t_1,\ldots,t_n)$-adic and $\mathfrak mC$-adic topologies: for every $r\ge0$ there exists $N\ge0$ with $\Phi((t_1,\ldots,t_n)^N)C\subseteq(\mathfrak mC)^r$. The equality on constants makes $\Phi$ an $F$-algebra map for the $F$-action through $\sigma$. This defines presentation data and makes no existence assertion.
